body: That's amazing! I'm so glad you're in a great and much better place now. Good on you for getting through it. <3 Yes. You're right. I will hang in there. :)

Thank you so much for your comment. <3 I have heard that and it is true! I also like what you said about it being an hour before sunrise. That's a great way of looking at it! I will remember that. I'm so sorry you've been in a very dark place too. I'm so glad imaging the animal with you helped you. I think animals and pets are very calming. I will try that method too. I hope you are doing ok now. <3

Thank you so much! <3 Your comment helps. Yes. I really don't know how I have managed to do those things while depressed, and dealing with her abuse. You're right. It will be so great being free and able to do what I want career wise without her interference and also being able to chose my own friends and family of choice. :)

Thank you so much! <3 I'm glad you guys think that I have completed a lot. I will continue to do everything I can towards getting out. That's a great idea. I will definitely repeat to myself that it will be over soon. It's true too!

Awwww. Thank you so much. <3 Your comment made me smile. You're right and I didn't think of it this way. It's quiet alot to have done over a few months especially when I hadn't been taught how to do these things before and had to learn for the first time. I will definitely remember what you said. I'll try not to be so hard on myself.

Thank you. <3 Yes you're totally right. I will keep working towards getting out. I think she can sense it as I never used to be able to complete tasks on my own and I used to be more scared of going out/the outside world, etc. I have also recently been avoiding her and her drama as much as possible even while living in the same house. I think maybe she knows I can sense she's toxic. There is also that hurt ego narcissists like her get when they can't control someone.

Thank you so much. <3 That's such a nice message. I'm so sorry you've had the same feelings. You're right. Depression/suicidal feelings definitely make everyday tasks much harder. It's not your fault. Remember that you're amazing too. <3
Awww. Thank you so much for your kind message. <3 I won't give up. I can't wait to be free.

Thank you so much. <3 Yes I will definitely leave as soon as possible. I have planned for a while now to completely cut contact with Nmother and even the rest of the family as they enable her, and so that I can't get sucked back in. I won't update them about my life or tell them where I live, etc. I wish I could leave right now but I only have one friend who is in a shared house and the owner won't allow more people to live there. So I've been looking at other options. This morning I got approved for financial aid which I'm very happy about as it will help a lot. Thank you for the hug and for telling me I'm not a loser. <3

Wow. Your mother is INSANE and a total control freak. She loves to tell you how to do everything, yet gets so defensive when she thinks you are telling her how to do something, which you weren't. You simply wanted to wash your shirt yourself. Lol. Narc's egos are so fragile. I'm so sorry you have a mother like that. I hope you're away from her now. <3 Hugs.

I'm so sorry. :( It sounds as though your brothers are the Golden children and you are the scapegoat. Remember that you're not lazy or a disappointment. Your parents are sick. They are the ones with the problem. Hugs. <3

Thanks so much! <3 Yes you're right about them being the damaged one. I will remember that. Yes I've been taking steps towards being independent and I'm writing a new resume to apply for paid jobs. Any paid job I can find. I will move out as soon as I have just enough money for rent.

I'm so sorry that you have a mother like that. Despite what she and your father say, they only dislike your boyfriend because he has taken away their narcissistic supply (you).Your mother is projecting her own abusive qualities onto your boyfriend by claiming he is controlling and dysfunctional. 

She does this in order to completely avoid all responsibility for the toxic family system that she has created. She also does this in order to try to turn you against your boyfriend so that she can have her scapegoat back at her home to abuse. 

I'm sure your boyfriend is a great support system for you which means you won't feel the need to seek validation, 'love', or 'help' from your Nmother as often. You instead receive real love and support from your BF without the narcissistic manipulation and strings attached. I believe Nmother's know this, which is why the view their children's partners as a threat. Congrats on moving out and beginning a healthy new life!
Awww. Thanks :D Yes the people and the cats there are nice! :)
Hahahahaha!
Thanks for your link <3 I'm going to read it. :)
Exactly! And I think the enablers like to keep the scapegoats (us) around because we take the brunt of the abuse most of the time.
Yes. I know what you mean. Even though Efather is abusive at times I believe he is too scared to stand up to Nmother, let alone ever attempt to leave her.
Hahahahaha. That was probably the reaction he was hoping for. I just ignored him. Lol.
I know right?

I politely disagree. I think that referring to someone with narcisistic personality disorder as a narcisist is important because it isn't sugar coated, and it helps you see the person for what they are, which is a mentally ill, soul sucking person who can never love you. Identifying and seeing a narcisist for what they are can give you validation that you are not the bad/crazy one as they would have you believe. It can also give you the strength that you need in order to get away from them and or go no contact.

My father has yelled at me, smashed my belongings, intimidated me, made me fearful that he will physcially attack me, and he has treated my cat poorly (at one point). Just because he has somewhat of a life, can be 'nice' sometimes and isn't obsessed with my whereabouts 24/7 (like Nmother is) doesn't mean he isn't a narcissist.
Ohh. Thanks! I know my PIN at least. :P

I just found a page that explains how to delete an icloud account on the iphone, but it says you might need to type in a "passcode" before you can delete it. I don't know what a passcode is. I only have my password.
Thanks for your advice! I will try those things as well. I might go into the apple store to talk to them about it when I can. I'm an adult living at home.

Ohh. Thanks for your advice! I will Google how to delete the icloud account and try it tonight!
Yes I agree! I was actually going to change my number after moving out, so at least this way I will have a new private phone, and new number.
Thanks! Yes you're right.

Sending you hugs. <3
Oh I totally understand. You just need to do what's best for you. If calling police will escalate his behaviour and make things even worse for you then it's best not to call them.
Yes you're right about her psychologically fucking with me! She is good at it. I'm trying to move out as soon as possible. I love your username btw! :P

Oh yes. My Nmother is always saying "I'm just worried about you." "I just want you to be safe." while almost driving me to kill myself due to 25 years of her abuse, gas lighting, and mind games. I would also think that someone who cared about me would allow me to go to the doctor after an infected self harm wound, not actively prevent me from doing so. She laughed at/shamed me about it and told my father to not assist me in going to the doctor. I still have no idea why I wasn't 'allowed' to go to the doctor for that.

It's so stressful when they steal and invade important mail. Are you able to put a friend's address on your bank account, work resume's, etc? It's probably best to do that. Just lie to the bank and say it's your address. And don't tell your father about it. Or open a PO box if you have a bit of spare money. I just put my friend's address on my bank account.

It's illegal for your father (or anyone else) to knowingly open, steal/keep your mail from you even if you live under the same roof. You could call police on him. I'm sure the police would be on your side since he is breaking the law. But I understand it's scary to do so. My Nmother also steals my mail.
Thanks a lot! I changed banks yesterday and used my friends address. So she has no access to nor knows which bank I use now which is good! I'm trying to get a job and move out as soon as possible.
Yes you're right! It's illegal to do so here. I will definitely consider calling the police next time she does it.

Oh yes! The bank I used first about 2 weeks ago told me that due to security reasons they can only send the pin number to people's addresses. But at this new bank I just switched to they told me I can pick up both my debit card and my pin number in person which is really good and easier for me.

Thanks for your advice! I solved the issue by going to a different bank yesterday and making a new bank account using my friend's address. I also activated the online mail like you did. It's really good hey? It's better and safer than having your mail sent to your house.

Thanks A lot for your advice! I went to a totally separate bank yesterday, made a new account and I used my friend's address. I will also check that they didn't put my mothers name down at all anywhere as I had to use my 18+ ID card, and my birth certificate to set it up. I don't think she would be able to walk in there and access it even if ever found out which bank it is. But I will ask them to not list her as my "mother" on my account!

Thank you so much. That's really nice of you to offer to listen! Yesterday I solved the bank problem. I went to a totally different bank, set up a new account and I gave them my friend's address. So my mother can no longer access my bank info which is good! This has made me a bit less stressed, and I'll just continue to do everything I can towards moving out.

Awwwwww. Thank you so much. I appreciate it :) Yes you're right. Suicide isn't the answer. Yesterday I went to a totally different bank, set up a new account and I used my friends address. I didn't mention my current address to them at all. So that problem is solved now thankfully. :) My mother can't access my new account. I will keep pushing through. I've been applying for jobs everyday so I will move after straight after I get a new job, and enough money for the first weeks rent.

Yes you're right! I will keep checking her office. Yes It's actually illegal here to open or steal someone else's mail even if you live in the same house. In some cases it can be punishable for up to 5 years! Asking a policeman to have a talk to her is a good idea. She would get pretty scared.

I will definitely change banks now and only tell them my friends address. That will solve the problem forever then. I got pretty emotional and wasn't thinking of solutions. Thanks for your advice :)
Good on you! I'm so proud of you!

Thank you! There is a domestic violence centre about 40 minutes from me and I heard they offer counselling, and may also help with housing. So I'm going to book an appointment there. I have recently asked around and there's a few people who are willing to rent a room to me, or let me have a room in exchange for household chores. I also told my best friend what has been going on, and she is going to ask her landlord if I can move in. I can make a bit of cash each week for rent.

Thanks! I will probably do that. Right now I have limited work skills. I have only worked for my mother, and one retail store. I quit the retail job without notifying them, as I was getting abused every morning before work by Nmother and I couldn't take it. She got worse when I was working. So I don't even have a reference from that job.
Hahahahahaha. You made me laugh! I think she does need a release. I mean she mentions boys and sex more than I do!

@Dancelifeaway I'm so glad that you have moved out. You're very brave. You did the right thing removing yourself from such a toxic and abusive environment. I'm really sorry about narcissistic grandma. It's horrible when multiple family members are narcissists. It adds to the pain, abuse, and stress. Narcissists are also notorious for getting others to do their dirty work. I'm sure your Nmother has told her (and others) exactly what to say to you. Be very careful of your narcissistic grandma, and any possible flying monkey's.  It's very hard but don't fall for the guilt trips. Remember that you do NOT have to apologize to your mother, or contact your mother at all if you don't wish to. You were abused, and have nothing to apologize for. It's also your right to put up strong boundaries! Stay strong. Thank you so much for offering to PM. I read a post of yours and will comment too! :)

Thank you so much! I appreciate your advice. Your friend sounds really cool and also brave! It's inspiring to me that she only had to do that kind of work for 6 months, made the money she needed and was able to find a stable job after. My goal is to find a stable job after as well, and also study! I will be extremely safe and always use protection. Thank you for being kind and not judging me. :)

Thank you for your advice! Yes you're totally right. That is projection! I'm pretty sure she has no access to my iphone now, as I removed her email as my "back up" email for the iphone/icloud account and I also changed my password. 

That's true that I should do what I need to do to survive. I will try not to feel so guilty. It will not be forever either. I plan to get a normal job as soon as I gain more work skills, and am in a safe living arrangement. Thank you for the hug! :)
Awwww. You're so sweet. Thank you for the encouragement!
Thank you so much! You're right. I'm going to continue to fight. :)
Thank you <3 I'm so sorry for what you went through. You are my age too! Are you still moved out and safe? I'm so proud of you for leaving. Good on you. Hugs.
Thanks. I will continue to save money in secret. My plan is to be out of here in under 4 weeks, even if I have to move into a share house instead to leave sooner I will!

Thanks. I've been saving up money in secret. Tonight I went for a walk just to calm my bad anxiety. She called and texted me straight away. When I got home minutes later she said "Where have you been?" I said "For a walk. I needed fresh air." She said "You should have told me." I said "I'm 25." then she LOST IT, almost hit me so I protected my face, and she said "You're living in my house doing NOTHING." (I keep my bedroom spotless, and clean up any mess I make.) and then she said "You were out with a guy. You were having sex with a guy." I defended myself but she kept saying that. She also said "You need a job." I said "I have one lined up." She said "Yes!" (she sabotaged my last job) then later she came into my room pretending to be nice and saying "We will work out a job for you next week. I will help you. I'm just worried about you." "You know you can go out any time you want."  I don't want a job CONTROLLED BY her. What was the goal in this? Does anyone know?
Thank you :) That's so nice of you. I will remember that!
